subject: Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation and clear alignment on where Redwood can lower inference costs for Starlite's care-coordination models. Per our chat, I wanted to put next steps in writing so we can get you through the AWS co-sell path (ACE) and into Marketplace listing discussion.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm primary procurement contact + expected procurement timeline
- ACE registration: we'd like to register Starlite's pilot opportunity and bring in the AWS PDM/PSM for alignment
- Marketplace listing: quick intake to understand any security/compliance docs you'll need for procurement

Attached: starlite-pricing-proposal.pdf (pricing sketch we ran during the demo).

Proposed next steps this week:
1) You loop in procurement and AWS PDM/PSM (if you want us to, we can request the PDM introduction)
2) We draft a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short checklist for ACE eligibility
3) Quick 30-min sync to align go/no-go and internal signoffs

Would Wednesday or Thursday afternoon work for a call?

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Attachment: starlite-pricing-proposal.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement <procure@starlitehealth.com>, AWS ACE Team <pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility

Tessa — thanks for the follow-up and the pricing doc. Looping in our procurement team and the AWS ACE contact per your ask.

A few quick notes from procurement:
- We typically need a draft SOW + brief on data handling and retention for vendor review (procure@starlitehealth.com).
- Targeting an internal decision by end of July, but we need PDM/PSM validation of co-sell path and any incentives.

Rajesh (cc'd) — can you confirm whether Starlite would be eligible for the ACE track based on a pilot opportunity and quick Marketplace listing? Also, please advise on PSM alignment for the pilot.

If helpful, we can share a short ROI template procurement prefers — otherwise, happy to use the pricing you shared.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships
Starlite Health
---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@amazon.com>, AWS ACE Team <pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood <> AWS PDM/PSM + MAP (draft)

Rajesh — great to be connected. Per Alicia and Starlite's note, we're pursuing ACE registration for a pilot opportunity with Starlite. Quick background: Redwood provides a hosted inference runtime optimized for high-throughput clinical NLP and embeddings; Starlite is evaluating a pilot to reduce token costs and improve latency for their patient matching pipeline.

Kimberly (cc) is our Partner Ops lead who will own the MAP and Marketplace intake; Marcus (cc) is on our Solutions team for security/compliance questions.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.docx — a short mutual action plan to speed alignment. Key asks in the draft:
- Target pilot scope (2 models, ~5M tokens/month)
- Timeline: 6–8 week pilot to validation
- Security docs: SOC 2, data residency notes, logging cadence

Requested next steps from AWS PDM/PSM:
1) Confirm ACE eligibility for co-sell runway and any incentives
2) Quick intro call (30 minutes) this week or next to triage Marketplace intake items
3) Confirm if any Marketplace packaging/partner onboarding items require pre-approval

Suggested times: Thu 18:00–19:00 UTC or Fri 15:00–16:00 UTC. Happy to adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.docx (Word doc, 55KB)

From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@amazon.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: AWS ACE Team <pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com>, procurement <procure@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 07:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood <> AWS PDM/PSM + MAP (draft)

Thanks for the context, Tessa and Alicia. Short answers up front:
- From the details provided, Starlite looks like a viable ACE candidate (pilot opportunity + clear enterprise intent).
- PSM alignment: we should include a PSM for pilot adoption and sales motion; I'll loop in the PSM separately.

Immediate asks to get ACE registration started:
1) Confirm SOW skeleton or an agreed list of deliverables for the pilot (simple 1-pager is fine)
2) Procurement contact (procure@starlitehealth.com is fine) and an expected procurement window
3) Complete the ACE checklist — I attached the checklist PDF for reference.

I can host a 30-minute triage at this time: Tue, Jun 24 16:00 UTC. Please confirm. Agenda: eligibility confirmation, PSM intro, Marketplace intake doc requirements.

Best,
Rajesh Kumar
Partner Development Manager — AWS ACE
Amazon Web Services
---
Attachment: aws-ace-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@amazon.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>, procurement <procure@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlite Health — ACE follow-up & kickoff scheduling

A quick follow from Redwood leadership: thanks, Rajesh — we confirm the Tue, Jun 24 16:00 UTC slot works and have invited our PSM counterpart internally. Pre-call asks from our side:
- Alicia/procurement: can you send the ROI template if you prefer to use it; otherwise the pricing proposal Tessa shared is fine.
- We'll bring a brief pilot SOW draft to the call to shorten the approval loop.

Look forward to the triage and to mapping a runway for Marketplace listing post-pilot.

Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Programs
Redwood Inference
---
(Invitation: Google Calendar event created for Tue, Jun 24 16:00 UTC)
